context_requirements: Expression of dopamine receptors, especially DRD3, in the assayed cell line
An intact dopamine receptor signaling pathway capable of modulating transcription
Sufficient incubation time for transcriptional changes to occur (likely >6 h)
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A consistent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of DRD3 pathway activation or downstream transcriptional regulation in these cell lines
